p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-top: 0pt

body.p: on application of Article 85 (3) of the Treaty to categories of agreements, decisions and concerted practices

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN COMMUNITIES,

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Having regard to the Treaty establishing the European Economic Community, and in particular Article 87 thereof;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Having regard to the proposal from the Commission;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Having regard to the Opinion of the European Parliament;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Having regard to the Opinion of the Economic and Social Committee;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas Article 85 (1) of the Treaty may in accordance with Article 85 (3) be declared inapplicable to categories of agreements, decisions and concerted practices which fulfil the conditions contained in Article 85 (3);

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas the provisions for implementation of Article 85 (3) must be adopted by way of regulation pursuant to Article 87;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas the creation of a common market requires that undertakings be adapted to the conditions of the enlarged market and whereas co-operation between undertakings can be a suitable means of achieving this;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas agreements, decisions and concerted practices for co-operation between undertakings which enable the undertakings to work more rationally and adapt their productivity and competitiveness to the enlarged market may, in so far as they fall within the prohibition contained in Article 85 (1), be exempted therefrom under certain conditions; whereas this measure is necessary in particular as regards agreements, decisions and concerted practices relating to the application of standards and types, research and development of products or processes up to the stage of industrial application, exploitation of the results thereof and specialisation;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas it is desirable that the Commission be enabled to declare by way of regulation that the provisions of Article 85 (1) do not apply to those categories of agreements, decisions and concerted practices, in order to make it easier for undertakings to co-operate in ways which are economically desirable and without adverse effect from the point of view of competition policy;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas it should be laid down under what conditions the Commission, in close and constant liaison with the competent authorities of the Member States, may exercise such powers;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas under Article 7 of Regulation No 17 agreements, decisions and concerted practices may by decision of the Commission be exempted from prohibition, in particular if they are modified in such manner that Article 85 (3) applies to them; whereas it is desirable that the Commission be enabled to grant by regulation like exemption to such agreements, decisions and concerted practices if they are modified in such manner as to fall within a category defined in an exempting regulation;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas the possibility cannot be excluded that, in a specific case, the conditions set out in Article 85 (3) may not be fulfilled; whereas the Commission must have power to regulate such a case in pursuance of Regulation No 17 by way of decision having effect for the future;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: HAS ADOPTED THIS REGULATION:

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 1

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 1. Without prejudice to the application of Regulation No 17 the Commission may, by regulation and in accordance with Article 85 (3) of the Treaty, declare that Article 85 (1) shall not apply to categories of agreements between undertakings, decisions of associations of undertakings and concerted practices which have as their object:

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (a) the application of standards or types;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (b) the research and development of products or processes up to the stage of industrial application, and exploitation of the results, including provisions regarding industrial property rights and confidential technical knowledge;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (c) specialisation, including agreements necessary for achieving it.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 2. Such regulation shall define the categories of agreements, decisions and concerted practices to which it applies and shall specify in particular:

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (a) the restrictions or clauses which may, or may not, appear in the agreements, decisions and concerted practices;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (b) the clauses which must be contained in the agreements, decisions and concerted practices or the other conditions which must be satisfied.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 2

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 1. Any regulation pursuant to Article 1 shall be made for a specified period.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 2. It may be repealed or amended where circumstances have changed with respect to any of the facts which were basic to it being made; in such case, a period shall be fixed for modification of the agreements, decisions and concerted practices to which the earlier regulation applies.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 3

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: A regulation pursuant to Article 1 may provide that it shall apply with retroactive effect to agreements, decisions and concerted practices to which, at the date of entry into force of that regulation, a decision issued with retroactive effect in pursuance of Article 6 of Regulation No 17 would have applied.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 4

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 1. A regulation pursuant to Article 1 may provide that the prohibition contained in Article 85 (1) of the Treaty shall not apply, for such period as shall be fixed by that regulation, to agreements, decisions and concerted practices already in existence on 13 March 1962 which do not satisfy the conditions of Article 85 (3), where:

p.style: font-family: 'Ariel Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: — within six months from the entry into force of the regulation, they are so modified as to satisfy the said conditions in accordance with the provisions of the regulation; and

p.style: font-family: 'Ariel Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: — the modifications are brought to the notice of the Commission within the time limit fixed by the regulation.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: A Regulation adopted pursuant to Article 1 may lay down that the prohibition referred to in Article 85 (1) of the Treaty shall not apply, for the period fixed in the same Regulation, to agreements and concerted practices which existed at the date of accession and which, by virtue of accession, come within the scope of Article 85 and do not fulfil the conditions set out in Article 85 (3).

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: The provisions of the preceding subparagraph shall apply in the same way in the case of the accession of the Hellenic Republic, the Kingdom of Spain and of the Portuguese Republic.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: The provisions of the preceding subparagraphs shall apply in the same way in the case of the accession of Austria, Finland and Sweden.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 2. Paragraph 1 shall apply to agreements, decisions and concerted practices which had to be notified before 1 February 1963, in accordance with Article 5 of Regulation No 17, only where they have been so notified before that date.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: Paragraph 1 shall be applicable to those agreements and concerted practices which, by virtue of the accession, come within the scope of Article 85 (1) of the Treaty and for which notification before 1 July 1973 is mandatory, in accordance with Articles 5 and 25 of Regulation No 17, only if notification was given before that date.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: Paragraph 1 shall not apply to agreements and concerted practices to which Article 85 (1) of the Treaty applies by virtue of the accession of the Hellenic Republic and which must be notified before 1 July 1981, in accordance with Articles 5 and 25 of Regulation No 17, unless they have been so notified before that date.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: Paragraph 1 shall not apply to agreements and concerted practices to which Article 85 (1) of the Treaty applies by virtue of the accession of the Kingdom of Spain and of the Portuguese Republic and which must be notified before 1 July 1986, in accordance with Articles 5 and 25 of Regulation No 17, unless they have been so notified before that date.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: Paragraph 1 shall not apply to agreements and concerted practices to which Article 85 (1) of the Treaty applies by virtue of the accession of Austria, Finland and Sweden and which must be notified within six months of accession, in accordance with Articles 5 and 25 of Regulation No 17, unless they have been so notified within that period. The present paragraph shall not apply to agreements and concerted practices which at the date of accession already fall under Article 53 (1) of the EEA Agreement.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 3. The benefit of the provisions laid down pursuant to paragraph 1 may not be claimed in actions pending at the date of entry into force of a regulation adopted pursuant to Article 1; neither may it be relied on as grounds for claims for damages against third parties.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 5

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: Before making a regulation, the Commission shall publish a draft thereof to enable all persons and organisations concerned to submit their comments within such time limit, being not less than one month, as the Commission shall fix.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 6

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 1. The Commission shall consult the Advisory Committee on Restrictive Practices and Monopolies:

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (a) before publishing a draft regulation;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: (b) before making a regulation.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 2. Paragraphs 5 and 6 of Article 10 of Regulation No 17, relating to consultation with the Advisory Committee, shall apply by analogy, it being understood that joint meetings with the Commission shall take place not earlier than one month after dispatch of the notice convening them.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-top: 6pt

body.p: This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.

p.style: font-size: 8pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
